finalists.label: Prosthetic Valve Thrombosis
finalists.why: It has the most specific evidence, including 4 days of progressive dyspnea on exertion and prothrombin time 32.8 s, INR 2.5.

finalists.label: Rheumatic heart disease
finalists.why: It has relevant evidence, including 4 days of progressive dyspnea on exertion and orthopnea, and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, with no significant findings against it.

finalists.label: Hemolytic Anemia
finalists.why: It is supported by the finding of hemoglobin 9.65 g/dL, which is a key indicator of hemolytic anemia.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and relevant evidence, including symptoms and lab results that are directly related to prosthetic valve thrombosis, such as 4 days of progressive dyspnea on exertion and prothrombin time 32.8 s, INR 2.5.
